regional_compliance.tax_context: Standard federal and provincial income tax; physician services are generally GST/HST exempt, while dental services have a more mixed exemption status depending on the specific service.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Standard provincial employment law; provincial privacy legislation (e.g. PHIPA in Ontario) governs patient data handling similarly to HIPAA in the US.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: Provincial medical/dental college licensure for providers, provincial health insurance billing registration (for physicians billing public insurance like OHIP), facility licensing where applicable.
key_compliance_terms: provincial College of Physicians and Surgeons licensing

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: Provincial public health insurance billing structures for physicians, GST/HST exemption status differences between medical and dental services, provincial privacy legislation compliance costs.

learning_objectives: Understand how billing under a provincial public health insurance system differs financially from a private multi-payer insurance model.
Analyze why medical and dental services have different GST/HST exemption treatment in Canada.
